notes: Eleven items queued from the 2026-09-17 poll, all read. Six name no address at all.

findings.description: Corey's Pizza opened at 3505 17th Street, near Guerrero Street, taking over the space that housed Turner's Kitchen until March 2025.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Corey’s Pizza is open and lowriders are coming to town,” 16 September 2026

raw.text: Corey’s Pizza is finally open! The long-awaited business took over the space at 3505 17th St., near Guerrero Street that housed Turner’s Kitchen until March 2025.

findings.note: A roundup column, so the headline carries a second, unrelated item about lowriders. It is published verbatim all the same — news/AGENTS.md forbids editing a headline, and the first half of it is the building fact.

publish.note: Published on /san-francisco/mission/guerrero-street/500/, which already existed — the assessor files parcel 3578001 as 500-504 Guerrero Street and EAS carries 3505 17th Street on it, so the page is on Guerrero rather than on the street the story prints. Nothing for the building block. The card is on the homepage news grid.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3505 17TH ST → parcel 3578001; sf-parcels has blklot 3578001 active, 3505–3505 17TH; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1908. The assessor files the parcel as 500–504 GUERRERO ST.

findings.description: A profile of The Magic Patio, a magic show running in a former cell-phone shop at 3264 Mission Street since 2017.

citation.label: Mission Local, “It’s no trick: Bernal’s hottest ticket is this perennially sold-out magic show,” 16 September 2026

publish.note: Declined on the ten-year test. Nothing happened at the building: the venue has been there since 2017 and the piece is a profile of the performer, a private individual. The headline — which is the whole entry — names neither the building nor the business, so on 3264 Mission Street's timeline it would state no fact about the building at all.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3264 MISSION ST → parcel 6596015; sf-parcels has blklot 6596015 active, 3264–3274 MISSION; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1906. EAS puts 3264, 3266, 3268, 3270, 3272, 3274 MISSION ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 3264.

findings.description: A six-months-in progress report on the Tenderloin's youth violence prevention programme, which operates from 518 Ellis Street.

citation.label: Mission Local, “Six months in, Tenderloin’s new anti-violence program has a lot to show for it,” 16 September 2026

publish.note: Declined on the ten-year test. This is an assessment of how a programme is doing, not an event at the building; the building is where the programme is housed. The opening of the centre would have been an entry — a progress report on its work is the clippings-file case news/AGENTS.md declines.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 518 ELLIS ST → parcel 0322004; sf-parcels has blklot 0322004 active, 518–530 ELLIS; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1915. EAS puts 518, 526, 530 ELLIS ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 518.

publish.note: Declined. This is a story about a candidate and his positions; the address is the subject of the policy argument, not of any event. The headline names a private individual standing for office and says nothing about the building.
